frozenCoreMeaning.en: The margin needed for range, reach, and organizational space to expand.

zh-Hans.title: 留白
zh-Hans.subtitle: 未被占满的空间本身就是运行资源

sections.title: 一句话理解
paragraphs: 真正有价值的空间，不一定需要立即填满。保留适当的时间、资源与选择余量，可以让我们更容易回应变化，也让新的可能逐渐出现。

sections.title: 这张卡想提醒什么？
paragraphs: 生活中，我们很容易认为没有安排的时间、空置的空间或尚未使用的资源是一种浪费。工作完成了，就增加新的任务；日程出现空档，就安排更多活动；有了额外预算，便考虑新的支出。
然而，当所有容量都被预先占满，现实出现变化时，我们可能已经没有足够空间作出调整。
「留白」邀请你观察：目前有哪些资源不需要立即投入？哪些空档值得暂时保留？
留白不是停止发展，而是让重要的事情拥有弹性。它既可以支持必要的恢复，也可以为尚未明确的新机会保留条件。
有时候，未被使用的容量，本身就是一种值得保护的资源。

sections.title: 现实中可能如何出现？
paragraphs: 工作
一个团队完成重要项目后，立即启动多个新功能，却没有保留处理真实顾客反馈与意外故障的资源。
适当预留维护和验证容量，可以让团队在新需求出现时更从容地回应。
家庭与生活空间
家庭日程已经安排得很满，孩子的活动、工作和家务几乎占据所有时间。
适当保留未安排的时段，可以为休息、临时需要和家庭共同活动提供弹性。
家居空间也一样，并非每个角落都必须摆放家具或物品。适当留白，可以改善通行与实际使用。
财务与个人发展
当收入增加或某项支出减少时，不一定需要立即增加新的长期承诺。
保留适当的现金余量，可以提高应对未来变化的灵活性。
个人学习也是如此。没有安排课程的时间，可以用于实践、整理已有知识，或观察自己真正希望继续发展的方向。

sections.title: 什么做法更有帮助？
paragraphs: 不要急着填满所有新出现的空间。
当时间、资金或其他资源变得可用时，先确认现有责任是否已经得到保障，再决定哪些资源值得投入、哪些适合保留。
留白可以有明确的目的，例如为临时需要、必要恢复或未来选择保留适当余量。

sections.title: 什么情况需要留意？
paragraphs: 留白最大的风险，是一旦出现新的空间，就立即用新的责任填满。
这样即使完成了旧工作，整体负荷也没有真正减少，新的发展机会仍然缺少空间。
另一方面，留白也不等于无限推迟必要行动。涉及明确责任、期限或安全的事项，仍需要适当处理。
好的留白，是有意识地保留余量，而不是忽略应该完成的事情。

sections.title: 现在可以做什么？
paragraphs: 1. 找出一项最近出现的空档或可用资源。
2. 检查它是否必须立即投入。
3. 尝试暂时保留其中一部分。
4. 观察这份余量是否改善了灵活性，或让新的需要更容易得到处理。

zh-Hans.frozenObservationQuestion: 什么空间如果暂时不被安排，会让新的东西有机会出现？
interpretationBoundary: 固定卡义用于观察和反思，不证明你目前的经历、能力或张力，也不预测未来。
这张卡描述的是可能支持扩展、选择与变化的环境余量，不代表系统已确认你目前缺少空间、资源或机会。实际留白应结合现有责任、经济条件、安全及现实需要决定。
sourceProposedQuestion: 什么空间如果暂时不被安排，会让新的东西有机会出现？

en.title: SPACE
en.subtitle: Unoccupied space is itself a resource

sections.title: At a Glance
paragraphs: Not every available space needs to be filled immediately. Preserving time, resources, and room for choice can make it easier to respond to change and allow new possibilities to emerge.

sections.title: What This Card Invites You to Consider
paragraphs: We often treat unallocated time, unused space, or available resources as something that must be filled. Once work is completed, more tasks are added. Free time becomes another activity. Additional funds become a reason for new spending.
But when every available resource is committed in advance, unexpected changes can become difficult to manage.
Space invites you to consider which resources do not need immediate allocation and which openings are worth preserving.
Leaving space does not mean abandoning progress. It creates flexibility for essential recovery, changing needs, and opportunities that have not yet become clear.
Sometimes available capacity is itself a resource worth protecting.

sections.title: How It May Appear in Real Life
paragraphs: Work
A team completes a major project and immediately begins several new features without preserving resources for customer feedback or unexpected defects.
Keeping some capacity available for maintenance and verification can make future responses more manageable.
Family & Living Space
A household schedule may be filled with children's activities, work, and domestic responsibilities.
Unallocated time can provide flexibility for rest, unexpected needs, and shared family activities.
The same applies to physical space. Not every corner needs furniture or storage. Leaving room can improve movement and everyday usability.
Finances & Personal Development
When income increases or an expense decreases, it is not always necessary to introduce another long-term commitment.
Preserving an appropriate financial margin can improve flexibility when circumstances change.
The same applies to learning. Time without scheduled courses can be used for practice, reflection, or identifying which direction deserves further development.

sections.title: A Helpful Approach
paragraphs: Avoid filling every newly available space immediately.
When time, funds, or other resources become available, first ensure essential responsibilities are covered.
Then decide what deserves investment and what should remain available for changing needs, recovery, or future choices.

sections.title: What to Watch For
paragraphs: The main risk is immediately filling newly available space with additional obligations.
When this happens, completing old work may not reduce overall demands, and new possibilities still lack room to develop.
Leaving space also does not justify indefinitely delaying essential action, deadlines, or safety responsibilities.
Useful space is intentionally preserved capacity, not neglected responsibility.

sections.title: One Small Action
paragraphs: 5. Identify a recently available period of time, space, or resource.
6. Check whether it must be committed immediately.
7. Keep part of it unallocated where practical.
8. Observe whether this margin improves flexibility or supports emerging needs.

en.frozenObservationQuestion: What space, if left unassigned for now, would let something new emerge?
interpretationBoundary: Fixed card meanings invite observation and reflection. They do not establish your current experiences, abilities or tensions, or predict the future.

This card presents environmental margin that may support flexibility, expansion, and new possibilities. It does not establish that you currently lack space, resources, or opportunities. The appropriate amount of unallocated capacity depends on existing obligations, finances, safety, and practical needs.
sourceProposedQuestion: What space, if left unassigned for now, would let something new emerge?

audit.personalFactConclusion: No live customer facts exported; no semantic approval inferred.

frozenCoreMeaning.zh-Hans: 这张牌代表通过渐进进入、反馈与分布式影响让环境逐步适配。
frozenCoreMeaning.en: A field that becomes supportive through gradual entry, feedback, and distributed influence.

zh-Hans.title: 校准
zh-Hans.subtitle: 环境通过持续微调与反馈支持更准确的运行

sections.title: 一句话理解
paragraphs: 真正适合的环境，不一定从一开始就已经完善。通过观察实际结果、逐步调整必要条件，可以让工作与生活安排越来越符合现实需要。

sections.title: 这张卡想提醒什么？
paragraphs: 生活中，我们经常希望一次找到最合适的方法、流程或安排。但现实条件会变化，真正有效的方式也可能需要通过实际使用才能逐渐形成。
「校准」邀请你观察：目前是否有某个小地方值得调整，而不需要重新改变整个计划？
例如，一项工作流程基本有效，只是交接时间不合适；家庭日程已经建立，但某个时段容易发生冲突。这些情况未必需要全面重新设计。
有效的校准，会保留仍然运作良好的部分，只调整真正影响结果的条件，再观察是否有所改善。
校准不是不断改变，而是让每一次调整都有明确原因与可观察的结果。

sections.title: 现实中可能如何出现？
paragraphs: 工作
团队发现报告交付流程整体正常，但顾客经常不清楚下一步应该在哪里下载。
与其重新设计整个平台，可以先改善下载指引，并通过实际测试确认是否减少疑问。
家庭
孩子放学后的安排基本稳定，但晚餐前经常因为时间太紧而发生冲突。
可以先调整一个活动的时间，而不是立即改变整套家庭日程，再观察新安排是否适合。
学习与个人安排
一个人已经建立学习计划，却发现某个时段经常无法专注。
可以尝试改变学习时间、减少单次任务范围，或调整环境中的干扰因素，再根据实际经验判断哪种方式较合适。

sections.title: 什么做法更有帮助？
paragraphs: 保留有效部分，只调整真正需要改变的条件。
先确认目前哪些安排已经正常运作，再找出一个具有实际影响的困难。
尽量一次调整少量因素，并使用相近的条件观察前后差异。这样更容易判断改变是否有效。

sections.title: 什么情况需要留意？
paragraphs: 校准最大的风险，是每次收到新反馈，就立即改变所有安排。
当工具、时间、步骤和责任同时改变，很难知道哪项调整真正产生效果，也可能让原本稳定的部分受到影响。
另一种风险，是只根据一次结果就认定调整成功或失败。某些变化需要适当的观察时间。
好的校准需要稳定的比较依据，也需要允许新的方法接受实际检验。

sections.title: 现在可以做什么？
paragraphs: 1. 选择一项基本有效、但仍存在小问题的安排。
2. 找出一个最值得改善的条件。
3. 保留其他部分，只进行一项小调整。
4. 经过适当观察后，比较实际结果是否改善。

zh-Hans.frozenObservationQuestion: 哪一个小调整最可能明显改善整个运行感受？
interpretationBoundary: 固定卡义用于观察和反思，不证明你目前的经历、能力或张力，也不预测未来。
这张卡描述的是通过渐进调整、现实反馈与适当协作形成支持的环境条件，不代表系统已经确认你的实际环境存在问题，或某项调整必然有效。改善效果仍需要通过实际观察和适当验证判断。
sourceProposedQuestion: 哪一个小调整最可能明显改善整个运行感受？

en.title: CALIBRATION
en.subtitle: The environment supports accuracy through ongoing adjustment

sections.title: At a Glance
paragraphs: A supportive environment does not have to be perfect from the beginning. Observing actual results and making small, purposeful adjustments can help arrangements become better suited to reality.

sections.title: What This Card Invites You to Consider
paragraphs: We often want to find the ideal method, process, or arrangement immediately. Yet conditions change, and practical experience may be necessary to understand what works best.
Calibration invites you to identify whether one small adjustment could improve the situation without redesigning everything.

A workflow may function well except for an inconvenient handover time. A household routine may be reliable except for a recurring scheduling conflict. Neither necessarily requires a complete overhaul.
Effective calibration preserves what already works, adjusts the relevant condition, and observes whether the result improves.
Calibration is not constant change. It is purposeful adjustment informed by feedback.

sections.title: How It May Appear in Real Life
paragraphs: Work
A report-delivery process works reliably, but customers frequently struggle to locate their downloads.
Instead of redesigning the entire platform, the team could improve download instructions and test whether confusion decreases.
Family
A child's after-school routine is generally stable, but activities repeatedly overlap with dinner preparation.
Adjusting the timing of one activity may be more useful than replacing the entire routine. The family can then observe whether the change helps.
Learning & Personal Routines
Someone has established a learning routine but finds that one particular time of day rarely works well.
Changing the study time, reducing the scope of each session, or adjusting environmental distractions may help identify a more suitable arrangement.

sections.title: A Helpful Approach
paragraphs: Preserve what works and adjust only what genuinely needs improvement.
Identify which parts of the current arrangement are already reliable, then select one meaningful difficulty.
Where practical, change only a small number of factors and compare outcomes under similar conditions. This makes it easier to evaluate whether the adjustment helps.

sections.title: What to Watch For
paragraphs: The main risk is changing everything whenever new feedback appears.

When tools, timing, processes, and responsibilities all change simultaneously, it becomes difficult to identify which adjustment produced an effect. Previously reliable elements may also be disrupted.
Another risk is declaring success or failure based on a single observation. Some changes require an appropriate period of review.
Good calibration requires a stable basis for comparison and meaningful evaluation of the new approach.

sections.title: One Small Action
paragraphs: 5. Choose an arrangement that generally works but has a recurring minor difficulty.
6. Identify one condition worth improving.
7. Preserve the other elements and make one small adjustment.
8. After an appropriate period, compare actual outcomes.

en.frozenObservationQuestion: Which small adjustment is most likely to improve the whole operating experience?
interpretationBoundary: Fixed card meanings invite observation and reflection. They do not establish your current experiences, abilities or tensions, or predict the future.

This card presents environmental conditions involving gradual adjustment, feedback, and appropriate coordination. It does not establish that your current environment has a problem or that any particular adjustment will succeed. Improvements should be evaluated through practical observation and appropriate verification.
sourceProposedQuestion: Which small adjustment is most likely to improve the whole operating experience?

frozenCoreMeaning.en: Conditions that open an entry, provide resources, or make operation more available.

zh-Hans.title: 支持
zh-Hans.subtitle: 条件到位时，结构能以较低摩擦开始运行

sections.title: 一句话理解
paragraphs: 真正的支持，不只是让人更有信心，而是提供实际需要的条件，使重要的事情能够更顺利地开始、持续和完成。

sections.title: 这张卡想提醒什么？
paragraphs: 生活中，有些事情迟迟无法顺利进行，并不一定是因为参与者缺少意愿或能力，而可能是必要的支持条件尚未具备。
例如，一项工作已经明确目标，却缺少适当工具；家庭成员愿意共同照顾孩子，却没有协调好时间；一个人希望学习新技能，却缺乏实践机会或必要指导。
「支持」邀请你观察：目前真正缺少的是什么条件？如果这个条件得到改善，是否能够减少反复协调、等待或额外努力？
好的支持不是替别人承担所有责任，而是让相关人员更容易完成自己应该负责的部分。
真正有效的支持，会降低运行成本，而不是让一切继续依赖某个人不断用力。

sections.title: 现实中可能如何出现？
paragraphs: 工作
团队已经具备完成任务的能力，却没有取得必要的系统权限或可靠资料。
提供适当授权、清楚的记录与操作工具，可能比不断要求员工加快速度更有效。
家庭
家庭成员愿意分担责任，但因时间安排和资料不清楚，仍然由同一个人处理大部分协调。
建立共享日程、明确分工与备用安排，可以让各方更容易参与。
个人发展
一个人希望发展专业技能，却不知道怎样把理论应用到实际项目。
适当的指导、练习机会与真实反馈，可能比继续增加课程更有帮助。

sections.title: 什么做法更有帮助？
paragraphs: 先找出阻碍行动的条件，再提供真正需要的支持。
可以检查：
- 资源： 是否缺少必要工具、资料、时间或资金？
- 权限： 相关人员是否能够合法、适当地执行任务？
- 协助： 是否需要指导、分工或专业支持？
支持应与实际需要相符，而不是提供越多越好。

sections.title: 什么情况需要留意？
paragraphs: 支持最大的风险，是逐渐取代原本应该由相关人员承担的责任。
例如，管理者为了帮助团队，开始亲自完成所有工作；家庭成员为了避免冲突，不断替别人处理本来已经明确分配的事务。
短期内问题可能得到解决，但长期可能形成依赖，让支持者承担越来越多负荷。
好的支持应该提升整体运行能力，而不是让所有事情更加依赖支持者。

sections.title: 现在可以做什么？
paragraphs: 1. 选择一件目前需要额外努力才能完成的事情。
2. 找出最主要的阻碍条件。
3. 确认需要什么工具、资源、权限或协助。
4. 尝试改善其中一个条件。
5. 观察工作是否变得更容易，而不是仅由别人代为完成。

zh-Hans.frozenObservationQuestion: 什么条件一旦存在，你会明显不需要那么用力？
interpretationBoundary: 固定卡义用于观察和反思，不证明你目前的经历、能力或张力，也不预测未来。
这张卡描述的是可能帮助事务启动与持续运行的环境支持条件，不代表系统已确认你缺少资源、能力或他人的支持。实际需求仍应通过现实条件、适当权限、明确责任与可观察的结果判断。
sourceProposedQuestion: 什么条件一旦存在，你会明显不需要那么用力？

en.title: SUPPORT
en.subtitle: When conditions are present, the structure can operate with less friction

sections.title: At a Glance
paragraphs: Real support does more than provide encouragement. It creates the practical conditions that make important activities easier to begin, sustain, and complete.

sections.title: What This Card Invites You to Consider
paragraphs: Sometimes activities remain difficult not because people lack motivation or capability, but because essential supporting conditions are missing.

A project may have a clear objective but inadequate tools. Family members may be willing to share childcare but lack coordinated schedules. Someone may want to develop a skill without access to suitable practice or guidance.
Support invites you to identify which condition is missing and whether improving it would reduce repeated coordination, delays, or unnecessary effort.
Good support does not replace another person's responsibilities. It makes those responsibilities easier to fulfill.
Effective support reduces operating costs rather than requiring continuous additional effort from one person.

sections.title: How It May Appear in Real Life
paragraphs: Work
A capable team cannot complete its work because essential system access or reliable information is unavailable.
Appropriate authorization, clear records, and suitable tools may help more than repeatedly asking employees to work faster.
Family
Family members are willing to share responsibilities, but unclear schedules and information leave most coordination with one person.
Shared schedules, clear roles, and backup arrangements can make participation easier.
Personal Development
Someone wants to develop professional skills but struggles to apply theoretical knowledge.
Appropriate guidance, practical opportunities, and meaningful feedback may be more useful than adding further courses.

sections.title: A Helpful Approach
paragraphs: Identify the condition preventing action, then provide support that addresses the actual need.
Consider:
- Resources: Are essential tools, information, time, or funds missing?
- Authority: Do participants have appropriate permission to perform the task?
- Assistance: Is guidance, shared responsibility, or professional support required?
Support should match actual needs rather than simply increase in quantity.

sections.title: What to Watch For
paragraphs: The main risk is allowing support to replace the responsibilities of those involved.
A manager may begin completing every task to help the team. A family member may repeatedly take over agreed responsibilities to avoid conflict.
This may resolve immediate difficulties while creating increasing dependence on the person providing support.
Good support strengthens the overall arrangement instead of making everything more dependent on the supporter.

sections.title: One Small Action
paragraphs: 6. Choose an activity that currently requires repeated extra effort.
7. Identify its main limiting condition.
8. Determine what tool, resource, permission, or assistance is needed.
9. Improve one supporting condition.
10. Observe whether the task becomes easier without simply transferring all responsibility to someone else.

en.frozenObservationQuestion: Which condition, if present, would noticeably reduce how hard you need to push?
interpretationBoundary: Fixed card meanings invite observation and reflection. They do not establish your current experiences, abilities or tensions, or predict the future.

This card presents environmental conditions that may support the initiation and continuation of activities. It does not establish that you lack resources, capability, or support from others. Actual needs should be assessed through practical circumstances, appropriate authority, clear responsibilities, and observable results.
sourceProposedQuestion: Which condition, if present, would noticeably reduce how hard you need to push?

frozenCoreMeaning.zh-Hans: 这张牌表示 ECR 基线窗口处于入口打开阶段。
frozenCoreMeaning.en: This card represents the opening position of the ECR baseline activation window.

zh-Hans.title: 开启
zh-Hans.subtitle: 入口刚刚出现

sections.title: 一句话理解
paragraphs: 有些新的可能刚刚出现，值得开始观察，但还没有足够证据证明它已经实现。开启的重点，是辨认新的入口与必要条件，而不是急着把可能性当成结果。

sections.title: 这张卡想提醒什么？
paragraphs: 生活中，新的方向有时会先以一个小机会出现：有人提出合作建议，一项工作开始具备执行条件，或者某个长期考虑的计划终于有了可以尝试的入口。
「开启」邀请你观察：目前究竟出现了什么新的可能？哪些条件已经具备？还有哪些事情尚未得到确认？
这并不意味着必须立即行动。某个机会刚刚出现，和它已经能够稳定运行，是两个不同的阶段。
真正有效的开启，是看清机会与条件，同时允许现实继续提供答案。

sections.title: 现实中可能如何出现？
paragraphs: 工作与事业
一项新服务已经完成初步设计，也找到愿意参与测试的用户。
这意味着实际测试的入口可能已经出现，但不代表产品已经获得市场验证。
家庭与生活
家庭成员开始讨论新的时间安排，也初步确认了可用资源。
这为改变提供了可能，但仍需要参与者确认责任，并在实际执行后观察是否可行。
学习与个人发展
你发现一个与现有经验相关的新职业方向，并了解到部分职位要求。
这可能是开始探索的入口，却不代表已经具备全部能力或一定适合转型。

sections.title: 什么做法更有帮助？
paragraphs: 先确认机会，再验证条件。
辨认已经出现的可能性，检查必要的资源、权限与现实限制，并选择一个低风险、范围明确的探索步骤。

sections.title: 什么情况需要留意？
paragraphs: 开启最大的风险，是过早把可能性解释成确定结果。
有人表达兴趣，不等于合作已经成立；完成初步设计，不等于产品能够交付；发现新机会，也不代表未来必然成功。
保持开放，同时让预期与证据一致。

sections.title: 现在可以做什么？
paragraphs: 1. 找出一个最近出现的新可能。
2. 写下目前已经确认的事实。
3. 列出仍然缺少的关键条件。
4. 选择一项小型、可验证的探索行动。

zh-Hans.frozenObservationQuestion: 现在有哪些条件只是刚刚变得可能？
interpretationBoundary: 固定卡义用于观察和反思，不证明你目前的经历、能力或张力，也不预测未来。
这张卡描述的是 ECR 模型中基线窗口的开启位置，并不代表系统已经确认某个现实机会出现，也不预测即将发生的事件。任何实际机会仍须通过相关事实与必要条件验证。
sourceProposedQuestion: 现在有哪些条件只是刚刚变得可能？

en.title: OPENING
en.subtitle: An entry is becoming possible

sections.title: At a Glance
paragraphs: Some possibilities are just beginning to emerge. They deserve attention, but there may not yet be evidence that anything has been achieved. Opening is about recognizing an emerging entry point without treating possibility as an established outcome.

sections.title: What This Card Invites You to Consider
paragraphs: New directions sometimes begin with a small opportunity: someone proposes a collaboration, a project gains the conditions needed for a trial, or a long-considered plan finally becomes possible to explore.
Opening invites you to identify what has become possible, which conditions are present, and what remains unconfirmed.
An opportunity becoming available is not the same as an arrangement already functioning reliably.
Meaningful opening recognizes possibilities and their requirements while allowing reality to provide further evidence.

sections.title: How It May Appear in Real Life
paragraphs: Work & Business
A new service has an initial design and potential test users.
A practical testing opportunity may now exist, but this does not establish market validation.
Family & Everyday Life
Family members begin discussing a new schedule and identify available resources.
This creates an opportunity for change, but responsibilities still need agreement and practical testing.
Learning & Personal Development
You discover a career direction connected to your experience and begin understanding its requirements.
This may open a path for exploration without establishing that you already meet every requirement or should make an immediate transition.

sections.title: A Helpful Approach
paragraphs: Recognize the opportunity before committing.
Identify what has become possible, review the resources, permissions, and constraints involved, and choose a manageable exploratory step.

sections.title: What to Watch For
paragraphs: The main risk is treating possibility as certainty.
An expression of interest is not a confirmed partnership. An initial design is not a delivered product. A new opportunity does not guarantee future success.
Remain open while keeping expectations aligned with evidence.

sections.title: One Small Action
paragraphs: 5. Identify a recently emerging possibility.
6. Record what is already confirmed.
7. List the essential conditions still missing.
8. Choose one small, verifiable exploratory action.

en.frozenObservationQuestion: Which conditions have only just become possible?
interpretationBoundary: Fixed card meanings invite observation and reflection. They do not establish your current experiences, abilities or tensions, or predict the future.

This card represents the opening position of the ECR baseline window. It does not establish that a real-world opportunity has appeared or predict an upcoming event. Actual opportunities must be evaluated through relevant facts and necessary conditions.
sourceProposedQuestion: Which conditions have only just become possible?

frozenCoreMeaning.en: This card represents the ECR baseline window crossing its entry threshold and beginning to operate.

zh-Hans.title: 启动
zh-Hans.subtitle: 结构越过入口，开始进入运行

sections.title: 一句话理解
paragraphs: 一个想法开始转化为行动，是重要的进展。但真正的启动，需要出现可以观察的结果，而不能因为事情已经开始，就认为它能够长期稳定运行。

sections.title: 这张卡想提醒什么？
paragraphs: 生活中，我们可能花费很长时间准备一项计划。最初只是一个想法，后来逐渐拥有资料、资源和执行条件，最终开始出现实际行动。
「启动」邀请你观察：哪些事情已经不只是计划，而是开始产生真实的运行迹象？
例如，一项产品开始接受实际测试，一种新的家庭安排开始执行，或者某项学习已经进入实践阶段。
这些变化值得记录，但启动不等于成熟。第一次成功不代表每次都能成功，短期有效也不代表长期可持续。
真正有价值的启动，是确认事情已经开始发生，同时继续观察它能否稳定运行。

sections.title: 现实中可能如何出现？
paragraphs: 工作与事业
一项新服务已经完成初步开发，并成功经过第一次完整测试。
这说明部分实际运行条件可能已经具备，但仍需要检查不同使用情况、错误处理与稳定交付。
家庭
家庭成员开始执行新的接送或家务安排。
即使第一天顺利，也需要观察新的分工是否适合每个人的时间与责任。
个人发展
一个人完成第一个实际项目，将过去学习的知识应用到真实问题。
这代表开始获得实践经验，但还不能仅凭一次作品确认已经完全具备专业能力。

sections.title: 什么做法更有帮助？
paragraphs: 确认启动迹象，再检查持续运行所需的条件。
观察三件事：实际完成了什么、哪些结果可以验证，以及下一次执行还需要什么资源或支持。
不必急着扩大规模。先确认基本流程能否重复完成，再决定是否继续增加投入。

sections.title: 什么情况需要留意？
paragraphs: 启动最大的风险，是把刚开始运行的事情，当成已经成熟的结构。
例如，一次测试成功就正式承诺大规模交付，或者某个新安排只执行几天，就认为未来不再需要调整。
启动代表开始，不代表已经具有充分的持续承载能力。

sections.title: 现在可以做什么？
paragraphs: 1. 选择一项刚刚开始实际执行的计划。
2. 记录已经出现的真实行动或成果。
3. 确认哪些部分尚未经过验证。
4. 安排下一次有限测试，观察能否稳定重复。

zh-Hans.frozenObservationQuestion: 什么已经不只是想法，而开始出现实际运行讯号？
interpretationBoundary: 固定卡义用于观察和反思，不证明你目前的经历、能力或张力，也不预测未来。
这张卡表示 ECR 模型中基线窗口越过入口阈值、开始运行的阶段位置，不代表系统已确认你现实中的某项计划、事业或关系已经启动。现实进展仍须通过实际行动、可观察结果与必要验证确认。
sourceProposedQuestion: 什么已经不只是想法，而开始出现实际运行讯号？

en.title: ACTIVATING
en.subtitle: The structure crosses entry and begins operating

sections.title: At a Glance
paragraphs: Turning an idea into action is meaningful progress. Yet genuine activation requires observable evidence, and a successful beginning does not guarantee that the arrangement can operate reliably over time.

sections.title: What This Card Invites You to Consider
paragraphs: We may spend considerable time preparing a plan. What begins as an idea gradually gains information, resources, and workable conditions until practical action becomes possible.
Activating invites you to identify what has moved beyond planning and begun producing observable signs of operation.
A product may enter practical testing. A household may begin using a new arrangement. Learning may move from reading into application.
These developments deserve recognition, but activation is not maturity. Initial success does not establish repeatability, and short-term effectiveness does not guarantee sustainability.
Meaningful activation recognizes that something has begun while continuing to examine whether it can operate reliably.

sections.title: How It May Appear in Real Life
paragraphs: Work & Business
A new service has completed initial development and passed its first end-to-end test.
This may demonstrate an initial operating capability, but different usage conditions, error handling, and reliable delivery still require verification.
Family
A household begins following a new schedule for pickups or domestic responsibilities.
Even if the first day goes smoothly, the arrangement still needs observation to determine whether it fits everyone's circumstances.
Personal Development
Someone completes a first practical project, applying previously learned knowledge to a real problem.
This marks the beginning of applied experience, but one project alone does not establish full professional competence.

sections.title: A Helpful Approach
paragraphs: Confirm activation, then examine what sustained operation requires.
Identify what has actually occurred, which outcomes are verifiable, and what resources or support would be needed for the next attempt.
There is no need to expand immediately. Establish whether the essential process can be repeated before increasing commitments.

sections.title: What to Watch For
paragraphs: The main risk is treating an early operating result as proof of maturity.
For example, one successful test may lead to premature promises of large-scale delivery, or a new arrangement may be considered permanent after only a few days.
Activation indicates a beginning, not proven long-term capacity.

sections.title: One Small Action
paragraphs: 5. Choose a plan that has recently entered practical execution.
6. Record the actions or outcomes that have actually occurred.
7. Identify what remains unverified.
8. Arrange another limited test to examine repeatability.

en.frozenObservationQuestion: What is no longer only an idea and is beginning to show operating signals?
interpretationBoundary: Fixed card meanings invite observation and reflection. They do not establish your current experiences, abilities or tensions, or predict the future.

This card represents the ECR baseline window crossing its entry threshold and beginning to operate. It does not establish that a particular plan, business, or relationship has actually started in your life. Real-world progress requires evidence from actual actions, observable outcomes, and appropriate verification.
sourceProposedQuestion: What is no longer only an idea and is beginning to show operating signals?

zh-Hans.title: 成势
zh-Hans.subtitle: 运行模式开始取得足够权重

sections.title: 一句话理解
paragraphs: 当一件事情开始获得更多关注、投入或实际回应，它可能逐渐影响接下来的选择。真正重要的，是观察这种影响是否形成了有意义的成果，而不是仅凭发展速度判断未来。

sections.title: 这张卡想提醒什么？
paragraphs: 生活中，有些事情刚开始时只占据很小的位置。一个新项目原本只是尝试，一项兴趣最初只是偶尔参与，或者一种新的工作方式只在少数情况下使用。
随着时间过去，如果它不断获得关注、资源与实际反馈，便可能逐渐影响其他决定。
「成势」邀请你观察：目前有什么事情，正在比以前更明显地影响下一步？
这种影响不一定代表成功。有些模式因为具有实际价值而扩大，也有些只是暂时获得更多关注。需要进一步检查的，是增加的投入是否带来可靠成果，以及现有资源能否支持后续发展。
成势不是预测某件事一定会壮大，而是提醒我们留意正在增加的影响力及其实际后果。

sections.title: 现实中可能如何出现？
paragraphs: 工作与事业
一项原本小规模测试的服务，开始获得更多实际使用和顾客反馈。
如果需求持续得到验证，团队可能需要重新安排开发与交付资源。但关注增加不等于已经具有稳定收入或大规模交付能力。
家庭与生活
家庭开始使用新的责任分工。经过一段时间，成员发现部分安排确实减少重复协调，于是愿意进一步采用。
新的做法开始影响日常生活，但仍需要确认它是否适合所有相关成员，并且能够持续执行。
个人学习与职业发展
一个人最初只是尝试学习某项技能，后来完成实际项目，并逐渐发现它与现有工作经验能够形成联系。
这项能力可能开始影响未来的职业选择，但仍需要通过更多作品、真实要求和适当反馈确认发展空间。

sections.title: 什么做法更有帮助？
paragraphs: 观察正在增加的影响，同时确认资源是否足以支持。
可以检查三个问题：
- 什么正在增加？ 是关注、实际需求、使用次数，还是资源投入？
- 产生什么结果？ 是否已经出现可核实的改善或成果？
- 能否持续？ 当前时间、资金与人员是否足以承担进一步发展？
根据实际证据决定是否增加投入，而不是因为某个方向开始受到关注，就立即扩大所有安排。

sections.title: 什么情况需要留意？
paragraphs: 成势最大的风险，是把不断增加的关注或行动量，直接解释成长期发展的保证。
有些活动虽然增长很快，却可能缺少稳定需求、可靠执行或必要资源。如果扩张速度超过实际承载能力，原本积极的发展也可能转化为新的负荷。
影响力增加值得观察，但不代表未来已经确定。

sections.title: 现在可以做什么？
paragraphs: 1. 选择一件最近变得越来越重要的事情。
2. 记录它在哪些方面获得更多关注或投入。
3. 检查是否有实际成果支持这种变化。
4. 评估现有资源能否承担下一步。
5. 决定继续观察、适度增加投入，还是暂缓扩大。

zh-Hans.frozenObservationQuestion: 什么正在比之前更明显地影响你的下一步？
interpretationBoundary: 固定卡义用于观察和反思，不证明你目前的经历、能力或张力，也不预测未来。
这张卡表示 ECR 模型中基线窗口的运行模式开始取得较高权重的阶段位置，不代表系统已经确认现实中的某项趋势正在增强，也不预测事业、关系或其他计划必然取得成果。实际发展仍须根据可观察的变化、资源条件与持续反馈判断。
sourceProposedQuestion: 什么正在比之前更明显地影响你的下一步？

en.title: GAINING WEIGHT
en.subtitle: The operating pattern begins to gain enough weight

sections.title: At a Glance
paragraphs: As an activity gains attention, resources, or practical responses, it may begin influencing what happens next. What matters is whether this growing influence produces meaningful outcomes, rather than assuming that momentum guarantees future success.

sections.title: What This Card Invites You to Consider
paragraphs: Some activities begin with very limited importance. A new project may start as an experiment, an interest may be pursued occasionally, or a different working method may initially be used only in a few situations.
Over time, continued attention, resources, and feedback may allow it to influence other decisions.
Gaining Weight invites you to consider what is becoming more influential in determining your next steps.

Greater influence does not automatically mean success. Some patterns expand because they create genuine value, while others simply attract temporary attention. What matters is whether growing investment produces reliable outcomes and whether available resources can support further development.
Gaining Weight does not predict inevitable growth. It draws attention to increasing influence and its practical consequences.

sections.title: How It May Appear in Real Life
paragraphs: Work & Business
A service initially tested on a small scale begins receiving more usage and customer feedback.
If demand is consistently verified, the team may reconsider development and delivery resources. However, growing attention does not establish reliable revenue or large-scale delivery capacity.
Family & Everyday Life
A household introduces a new division of responsibilities. Over time, certain arrangements appear to reduce repeated coordination, encouraging wider use.
The new approach begins influencing everyday routines, but its suitability for everyone involved and its sustainability still require evaluation.
Learning & Career Development
Someone begins exploring a skill and later completes practical projects that reveal connections with existing professional experience.
The skill may start influencing future career decisions, but further work, actual role requirements, and meaningful feedback are needed to evaluate its potential.

sections.title: A Helpful Approach
paragraphs: Observe growing influence while checking whether sufficient capacity exists.
Consider:
- What is increasing? Attention, actual demand, usage, or investment?
- What is the result? Are there verifiable improvements or outcomes?
- Can it continue? Are time, funding, and people sufficient for further development?
Use evidence to guide additional commitments rather than expanding immediately because a direction is receiving more attention.

sections.title: What to Watch For
paragraphs: The main risk is treating increasing attention or activity as a guarantee of long-term success.
Some activities grow quickly without stable demand, reliable execution, or sufficient resources. When expansion exceeds practical capacity, positive momentum can create new burdens.
Growing influence deserves observation, but it does not make future outcomes certain.

sections.title: One Small Action
paragraphs: 6. Choose something that has become increasingly important.
7. Record how its attention or investment has grown.
8. Check whether actual outcomes support that growth.
9. Assess whether existing resources can sustain the next step.
10. Decide whether to observe further, expand gradually, or pause expansion.

zh-Hans.title: 放大
zh-Hans.subtitle: 周围条件让活动模式变得更明显

sections.title: 一句话理解
paragraphs: 当周围环境发生变化，原本不明显的优势、问题或运行方式，可能逐渐变得更加清楚。放大的价值，是帮助我们看见实际情况，而不是把更高的关注度直接当成成功。

sections.title: 这张卡想提醒什么？
paragraphs: 生活中，有些事情并不是最近才出现，而是因为环境改变，我们才开始明显注意到它们。
一项产品获得更多使用者之后，原本不明显的功能问题可能开始频繁出现；一个家庭的生活安排改变后，过去隐藏的责任分工问题也可能变得突出。
「放大」邀请你观察：目前变得更加明显的事情，究竟是刚刚出现，还是原本已经存在，只是现在更容易被看见？
当某种模式被放大，我们便有机会更清楚地观察它的实际影响。但更明显不代表更正确，更多关注也不一定意味着更高价值。

sections.title: 现实中可能如何出现？
paragraphs: 工作与事业
一项数字服务经过宣传后，使用人数增加。团队可能同时发现顾客兴趣提高，以及交付流程中原本不明显的问题。
这时需要分别检查真实需求、系统表现与实际成本，而不是只根据浏览量判断产品成功。
家庭与关系
家庭成员的工作时间发生变化后，原本由一人承担的大量协调工作开始变得明显。
这不一定表示问题刚刚产生，而可能是新环境让过去的责任安排更容易被看见。
个人能力与发展
一个人开始参与更大型的项目后，过去的沟通、分析或执行方式可能获得更多反馈。
这些反馈既可能揭示已有能力，也可能指出需要改善的地方。
当参与范围扩大，实际表现比单纯的自我评价更值得参考。

sections.title: 什么做法更有帮助？
paragraphs: 利用更明显的反馈，看清原本的运行方式。
观察三个问题：
- 什么被放大？ 是需求、成果、问题还是成本？
- 为什么更明显？ 哪些环境或参与条件改变了？
- 实际说明什么？ 是否有足够证据支持目前的判断？
先确认变化的原因，再决定是否扩大投入或调整安排。

sections.title: 什么情况需要留意？
paragraphs: 放大最大的风险，是将更明显误认为更正确。
一项产品获得更多关注，不代表已经具备稳定交付能力；一个问题频繁出现，也不一定代表它比其他问题更重要。
放大可能同时增加优势与偏差。如果没有核对实际结果，扩大投入也可能扩大原本的成本。
被看见的程度，不应该取代对真实价值与风险的判断。

sections.title: 现在可以做什么？
paragraphs: 1. 找出一件最近变得特别明显的事情。
2. 检查哪些周围条件发生了变化。
3. 区分实际变化与关注度增加。
4. 根据可靠反馈，决定是否需要调整下一步。

zh-Hans.frozenObservationQuestion: 最近什么因为环境变化而变得特别明显？
interpretationBoundary: 固定卡义用于观察和反思，不证明你目前的经历、能力或张力，也不预测未来。
这张卡描述的是 ECR 模型中基线窗口的场域放大阶段，不代表系统已经确认现实中的某项趋势、能力或问题正在增强，也不预测未来结果。实际变化仍须根据可观察的事实与相关条件验证。
sourceProposedQuestion: 最近什么因为环境变化而变得特别明显？

en.title: AMPLIFYING
en.subtitle: Surrounding conditions make the active pattern more visible

sections.title: At a Glance
paragraphs: Changes in surrounding conditions can make existing strengths, problems, or operating patterns more visible. The value of amplification is clearer observation—not treating greater attention as proof of success.

sections.title: What This Card Invites You to Consider
paragraphs: Some patterns are not new. They simply become easier to notice when surrounding conditions change.
A product may reveal previously unnoticed defects after attracting more users. A change in household routines may make an existing imbalance in responsibilities more visible.
Amplifying invites you to ask: Has something genuinely emerged, or have changing circumstances made an existing pattern easier to observe?
Greater visibility creates an opportunity for clearer understanding. It does not automatically establish accuracy, value, or long-term success.

sections.title: How It May Appear in Real Life
paragraphs: Work & Business
A digital service attracts more users after promotion. The team may observe increased interest alongside previously unnoticed delivery problems.
Actual demand, system performance, and operating costs should be examined separately rather than using traffic alone as proof of success.
Family & Relationships
Changing work schedules may reveal how much household coordination has depended on one family member.
The issue may not be new. Different circumstances may simply make the existing arrangement more visible.
Personal Capabilities & Development
Someone joining a larger project may receive more feedback on their communication, analysis, or execution.
That feedback may reveal existing capabilities as well as areas needing improvement.
As participation expands, observed performance becomes more informative than self-assessment alone.

sections.title: A Helpful Approach
paragraphs: Use increased visibility to understand the existing pattern.
Consider:
- What is amplified? Demand, outcomes, problems, or costs?
- Why is it more visible? Which surrounding conditions have changed?
- What does the evidence show? Are current conclusions supported?
Identify the reasons behind the change before expanding commitments or revising arrangements.

sections.title: What to Watch For
paragraphs: The principal risk is confusing greater visibility with greater validity.
More attention does not establish reliable product delivery. A frequently noticed problem is not automatically the most consequential one.
Amplification may increase both benefits and distortions. Without evaluating actual outcomes, greater investment may also increase existing costs.
Visibility should not replace evidence-based judgment of value and risk.

sections.title: One Small Action
paragraphs: 5. Identify something that has recently become more noticeable.
6. Examine which surrounding conditions have changed.
7. Distinguish actual change from increased visibility.
8. Use reliable feedback to decide whether the next step needs adjustment.

frozenCoreMeaning.en: This card represents an alignment position in the ECR baseline activation window.

zh-Hans.title: 对齐
zh-Hans.subtitle: 条件暂时形成较低摩擦的组合

sections.title: 一句话理解
paragraphs: 有些事情之所以变得顺利，不一定是因为我们更加努力，而是相关条件暂时能够互相配合。真正重要的，是善用这样的机会，同时为未来可能发生的变化保留弹性。

sections.title: 这张卡想提醒什么？
paragraphs: 生活中，有些事情原本需要反复协调，却可能在某个阶段突然变得容易。工作资源已经准备好，相关人员有时间参与，必要的资料也得到确认，使一项计划能够更顺利地执行。
「对齐」邀请你观察：目前有哪些条件正在互相配合，让原本困难的事情更容易进行？
这种顺畅值得利用，但不代表所有条件都会永远保持相同。人员安排、资源与外部环境仍可能变化。
有效的对齐，是在条件合适时推进重要事情，同时继续观察现实。

sections.title: 现实中可能如何出现？
paragraphs: 工作与项目
一项数字服务已经完成必要测试，相关负责人有时间进行验收，交付流程和文件也准备妥当。
在适当授权与验证条件下，这可能是推进正式交付的有利时机，而不必继续增加无关功能。
家庭与生活
家庭成员的时间暂时能够配合，资金与必要安排也已经明确，因此某项长期讨论的家居改善计划可能更容易执行。
但仍应确认预算、施工条件和家庭责任，而不是因为安排顺利，就忽略后续影响。
学习与职业发展
一个人希望学习新技能，近期刚好拥有适当时间、相关项目和可获得的指导。
这些条件的组合，可能让实践学习比过去更容易。
但开始学习并不代表已经掌握能力，仍需要通过实际成果验证。

sections.title: 什么做法更有帮助？
paragraphs: 先确认哪些条件已经具备，再优先完成最值得推进的事情。
可以检查：
- 资源： 必要时间、人员和工具是否到位？
- 协调： 相关责任和参与安排是否清楚？
- 成果： 哪件重要事情最适合在当前条件下完成？
善用条件较顺畅的阶段，同时保留后续检查与调整空间。

sections.title: 什么情况需要留意？
paragraphs: 对齐最大的风险，是把暂时顺畅误认为永久状态。
例如，一项服务因为目前使用量较少而运行顺利，不代表未来扩大后仍然稳定；一次家庭安排成功，也不代表之后不再需要协调。
另一个风险，是因为当前条件有利，就过度增加新的责任，使原本低摩擦的安排重新变得拥挤。
顺畅值得利用，但不能代替长期承载能力的验证。

sections.title: 现在可以做什么？
paragraphs: 1. 找出一件目前比过去更容易推进的事情。
2. 确认哪些条件正在提供支持。
3. 选择一项最值得完成的实际行动。
4. 完成后检查结果，并记录未来仍可能变化的条件。

zh-Hans.frozenObservationQuestion: 什么事情在条件对齐时最值得优先推进？
interpretationBoundary: 固定卡义用于观察和反思，不证明你目前的经历、能力或张力，也不预测未来。
这张卡描述的是 ECR 模型中基线窗口的条件对齐阶段，不代表系统已经确认你的现实条件正在变得顺利，也不预测某项计划即将成功。实际机会仍需要根据资源、责任、授权与可观察结果判断。
sourceProposedQuestion: 什么事情在条件对齐时最值得优先推进？

en.title: ALIGNMENT
en.subtitle: Conditions temporarily align with lower friction

sections.title: At a Glance
paragraphs: Sometimes things become easier not because we work harder, but because the necessary conditions temporarily fit together. What matters is making good use of that opportunity while preserving flexibility for future changes.

sections.title: What This Card Invites You to Consider
paragraphs: Some activities that previously required extensive coordination can become easier when the right conditions come together. Resources are ready, relevant people are available, and essential information has been confirmed.
Alignment invites you to recognize which conditions are working together and making progress easier.
This opportunity may be worth using, but it does not mean those conditions will remain unchanged. People, resources, and external circumstances can still shift.
Useful alignment means advancing worthwhile work while conditions cooperate, without losing touch with reality.

sections.title: How It May Appear in Real Life
paragraphs: Work & Projects
A digital service has completed essential testing, relevant reviewers are available, and delivery processes and files are ready.
With appropriate authorization and verification, this may be a suitable opportunity to advance delivery rather than add unrelated features.
Family & Everyday Life
Family schedules temporarily fit together, and necessary resources are available, making a long-discussed home improvement project easier to undertake.
Budgets, practical requirements, and family responsibilities still need consideration rather than assuming that favorable timing eliminates all risks.
Learning & Career Development
Someone wanting to learn a new skill now has suitable time, a relevant project, and access to guidance.
These conditions may make practical learning easier than before.
Beginning under favorable circumstances does not establish competence; actual results are still needed.

sections.title: A Helpful Approach
paragraphs: Identify what is ready, then prioritize the most worthwhile coordinated action.
Consider:
- Resources: Are the necessary time, people, and tools available?
- Coordination: Are responsibilities and participation arrangements clear?
- Outcome: Which important task would benefit most from the current conditions?
Use favorable conditions productively while retaining room for review and adjustment.

sections.title: What to Watch For
paragraphs: The principal risk is treating temporary alignment as permanent.
A service may run smoothly with limited usage without being ready for a larger scale. One successful household arrangement does not eliminate the need for future coordination.
Another risk is introducing excessive new commitments simply because current conditions are favorable, gradually making the arrangement more demanding again.
Favorable conditions deserve attention, but they do not replace verification of long-term capacity.

sections.title: One Small Action
paragraphs: 5. Identify something that has recently become easier to advance.
6. Clarify which conditions are providing support.
7. Choose one worthwhile practical action.
8. Review the result and record which conditions may change later.

This card represents an alignment position within the ECR baseline window. It does not establish that your real-world circumstances are becoming favorable or predict success in a particular undertaking. Actual opportunities must be evaluated through resources, responsibilities, authorization, and observable outcomes.

zh-Hans.title: 过度放大
zh-Hans.subtitle: 激活强度开始超过较平衡范围

sections.title: 一句话理解
paragraphs: 当一件事情发展顺利，我们容易继续增加投入。但更多不一定代表更好。真正重要的是辨认适当强度，在成果开始受到影响之前，保留必要的资源与调整空间。

sections.title: 这张卡想提醒什么？
paragraphs: 生活中，有些安排最初非常有效。一个团队找到合适的工作方式，便不断增加项目；一项产品获得顾客认可，便持续推出更多功能；一个人发现新的学习方法有效，于是不断延长学习时间。
然而，原本能够带来成果的做法，并不一定适合无限增加强度。
「过度放大」邀请你观察：目前是否有某件事情，因为投入越来越多，反而开始失去原来的效果？
例如，工作速度提高了，但错误也开始增加；活动安排更丰富了，却减少了必要的休息和协调空间；产品功能增加了，顾客使用起来反而更加复杂。
这些现象并不自动证明已经发生过度放大，却值得进一步检查投入与结果之间的关系。
真正有效的发展，不是不断增加强度，而是让行动与可用容量保持适当平衡。

sections.title: 现实中可能如何出现？
paragraphs: 工作与产品开发
一项数字服务开始获得更多顾客，团队于是同时增加功能、宣传及新产品开发。
短期内活动明显增加，但如果测试、维护和交付资源没有相应改善，原本可靠的服务也可能出现问题。
适当的回应，是核对真实需求、交付能力与维护成本，而不是只因为增长顺利，就无限扩大开发范围。
家庭与日常安排
家庭发现孩子喜欢参加某项活动，于是逐渐增加课程与课外安排。
即使活动本身有价值，过于紧密的时间表仍可能影响休息、交通与家庭协调。
这时不一定需要停止所有活动，而是重新检查哪些安排真正值得保留，以及活动频率是否适合孩子和家庭的实际需要。
学习与个人发展
一个人发现集中学习能够取得不错的成果，于是不断增加课程、练习和项目。
如果学习时间持续增加，却开始缺少实际应用和整理知识的空间，进一步投入未必能够带来同等程度的改善。
适当减少同时进行的内容，完成一个实际项目，可能更容易验证已经取得的能力。

sections.title: 什么做法更有帮助？
paragraphs: 保留有效部分，降低不必要的强度。
可以检查：
- 什么正在增加？ 工作量、参与人数、功能、活动还是资金投入？
- 效果是否同步改善？ 有没有真实成果支持继续扩大？
- 容量是否足够？ 时间、资源、维护和恢复条件是否仍然适合？
如果新增投入开始产生额外成本，可以先减少非必要部分，保留真正有效的活动，再根据反馈调整。

sections.title: 什么情况需要留意？
paragraphs: 过度放大 最大的风险，是认为既然某种做法曾经成功，就应该不断提高投入强度。
当原本有效的模式被过度使用，它可能逐渐变得僵化、复杂，甚至增加持续运行的成本。
另一种风险，是把任何增长都解释成过度放大。有些扩大确实合理，也有足够资源支持，不能只因为活动增加就认定存在问题。
判断的依据应当是实际效果与承载能力，而不是单纯的增长速度。

sections.title: 现在可以做什么？
paragraphs: 1. 选择一项最近不断增加投入的事情。
2. 检查实际成果是否仍然同步改善。
3. 找出一个可能已产生额外成本的部分。
4. 在不影响必要责任的情况下，尝试降低一项非必要强度。
5. 观察是否恢复了效率、余量或更稳定的结果。

zh-Hans.frozenObservationQuestion: 什么正在因为「太多」而开始失去原本的效果？
interpretationBoundary: 固定卡义用于观察和反思，不证明你目前的经历、能力或张力，也不预测未来。
这张卡表示 ECR 模型中基线窗口的激活过度放大阶段，并非坏预兆，也不代表系统已经确认你现实中出现过载、健康问题、事业失控或其他负面结果。是否需要降低投入，仍应依据实际负荷、可用资源与可观察的结果判断。
sourceProposedQuestion: 什么正在因为「太多」而开始失去原本的效果？

en.title: OVERAMPLIFICATION
en.subtitle: Activation intensity begins to exceed a balanced range

sections.title: At a Glance
paragraphs: When something is progressing well, it can be tempting to keep increasing investment. But more does not always mean better. What matters is recognizing an appropriate level of intensity and preserving the resources and flexibility needed for continued operation.

sections.title: What This Card Invites You to Consider
paragraphs: Some arrangements work particularly well at first. A team finds an effective process and begins taking on more projects. A product receives positive feedback, leading to more features. Someone discovers an effective study method and continually increases study hours.
Yet a method that produces good results does not necessarily remain effective at unlimited intensity.
Overamplification invites you to consider whether increasing investment has begun to reduce the effectiveness of something that previously worked well.

A team may work faster while errors increase. A household may schedule more activities while losing essential rest and coordination time. A product may gain features while becoming harder for customers to use.
These observations do not automatically prove overamplification, but they provide reasons to examine the relationship between effort and outcomes.
Sustainable development is not about increasing intensity indefinitely. It is about keeping activity proportionate to available capacity.

sections.title: How It May Appear in Real Life
paragraphs: Work & Product Development
A digital service attracts more customers, encouraging the team to increase features, promotion, and new development simultaneously.
Activity may grow quickly, but without adequate testing, maintenance, and delivery capacity, an existing reliable service may become less dependable.
A useful response is to examine actual demand, delivery capacity, and maintenance costs rather than expanding indefinitely because early growth appears favorable.
Family & Everyday Routines
A child enjoys an activity, so the family gradually adds more lessons and extracurricular commitments.
Even worthwhile activities can create scheduling difficulties when time for rest, travel, and family coordination becomes limited.
The answer is not necessarily to stop everything, but to reconsider which activities deserve priority and whether their frequency fits the child's and household's needs.
Learning & Personal Development
Someone discovers that focused learning produces good results and begins adding courses, exercises, and projects.
If additional study leaves little time for application or consolidation, further input may not create equivalent improvement.
Reducing simultaneous commitments and completing a practical project may provide clearer evidence of what has actually been learned.

sections.title: A Helpful Approach
paragraphs: Preserve what works while reducing unnecessary intensity.
Consider:
- What is increasing? Workload, participation, features, activities, or financial commitments?
- Are outcomes improving accordingly? Does real evidence justify further expansion?
- Is capacity sufficient? Are time, resources, maintenance, and recovery conditions still appropriate?
If additional investment begins creating excessive costs, reduce nonessential activity while protecting what remains useful, then reassess through feedback.

sections.title: What to Watch For
paragraphs: The main risk is assuming that because an approach worked previously, its intensity should continually increase.
When an effective pattern is pushed too far, it may become rigid, unnecessarily complex, or increasingly expensive to maintain.
The opposite risk is labeling every expansion as excessive. Some growth is appropriate and adequately supported.
The appropriate basis for judgment is actual performance and capacity, not the speed of growth alone.

sections.title: One Small Action
paragraphs: 6. Choose something that has received increasing investment recently.
7. Check whether outcomes are improving proportionately.
8. Identify one area where additional effort may be creating extra costs.
9. Reduce one nonessential demand without neglecting important obligations.
10. Observe whether efficiency, available margin, or reliability improves.

en.frozenObservationQuestion: What is beginning to lose effectiveness because there is too much of it?
interpretationBoundary: Fixed card meanings invite observation and reflection. They do not establish your current experiences, abilities or tensions, or predict the future.

This card represents the overamplification stage within the ECR baseline window. It is not a bad omen and does not establish that you are experiencing overload, a medical condition, business failure, or another negative outcome. Decisions about reducing intensity must be grounded in actual demands, available resources, and observable results.

zh-Hans.title: 回落
zh-Hans.subtitle: 活动配置开始失去可用能量或场域支持

sections.title: 一句话理解
paragraphs: 有些事情不需要永远保持相同强度。当实际需求、资源或支持逐渐减少时，适当降低投入，可以为恢复、整理及新的安排保留空间。

sections.title: 这张卡想提醒什么？
paragraphs: 生活中的许多活动都有不同阶段。一个项目开始时需要集中投入，进入稳定运行后可能只需要定期维护；一项家庭事务完成主要安排后，也可能不再需要频繁协调。
「回落」邀请你观察：目前是否有某件事情，已经不需要继续维持过去的投入强度？
我们有时会因为过去付出了大量努力，而希望原有安排一直保持活跃。然而，当现实需要已经改变，继续维持相同强度，未必能够产生相应价值。
回落并不等于失败。有些工作已经完成主要作用，有些活动适合降低频率，也有些计划需要暂停以恢复资源。
重要的是根据实际条件判断，哪些部分需要继续、哪些可以减少，以及哪些应当为下一阶段作准备。

sections.title: 现实中可能如何出现？
paragraphs: 工作与项目
一个数字产品已经完成主要开发，核心功能也经过适当验证。团队可能不再需要维持开发阶段的工作强度，而可以转向必要维护、顾客支持与后续观察。
家庭与生活
家庭完成搬迁或装修后，原本密集的协调工作逐渐减少。
此时可以整理文件、处理剩余责任，并让日常安排恢复较稳定的节奏，而不必继续保持项目期间的忙碌状态。
个人发展
一个人完成某阶段的学习目标后，可能不需要继续参加同样密集的课程。
将部分时间转向实际应用、复查成果或休息，可能比不断增加新的学习任务更有帮助。

sections.title: 什么做法更有帮助？
paragraphs: 根据当前需要调整投入，而不是维持过去的强度。
检查哪些任务仍然必要、哪些已经完成主要目的，以及哪些资源可以转向维护、恢复或下一阶段准备。
降低强度之前，也要确认现有承诺和持续性责任仍然得到妥善处理。

sections.title: 什么情况需要留意？
paragraphs: 回落最大的风险，是为了维持过去的状态，不断增加新的投入。
当某项活动已经不需要原来的规模，却仍然持续加入任务或资源，可能延长不必要的成本。
另一种风险，是把暂时减少误认为必须立即结束。有些活动只是进入较低强度的阶段，并不代表其长期价值已经消失。
适当回落，不等于取消所有持续责任。

sections.title: 现在可以做什么？
paragraphs: 1. 选择一项过去需要大量投入的活动。
2. 检查目前的实际需求与支持是否已经改变。
3. 确认哪些责任仍然必须保留。
4. 适当减少一项非必要投入，并将资源转向恢复或后续准备。

zh-Hans.frozenObservationQuestion: 什么已经可以不用再维持原来的强度？
interpretationBoundary: 固定卡义用于观察和反思，不证明你目前的经历、能力或张力，也不预测未来。
这张卡表示 ECR 模型中基线窗口的激活回落阶段，不代表系统已经确认你现实中的事业、关系、健康或其他事务正在衰退，也不预测某件事情即将结束。卡片中的「能量」是模型对可用资源及支持条件的描述，并非医学测量。实际调整应根据可核实的情况与必要责任决定。
sourceProposedQuestion: 什么已经可以不用再维持原来的强度？

en.title: DECAY
en.subtitle: The active configuration begins losing energy or field support

sections.title: At a Glance
paragraphs: Not everything needs to operate at the same intensity forever. When demand, resources, or support begin declining, reducing effort appropriately can create room for recovery, consolidation, and future arrangements.

sections.title: What This Card Invites You to Consider
paragraphs: Many activities move through different stages. A project may require concentrated effort during development but only periodic maintenance once established. A household arrangement may require less coordination after its main changes have been completed.
Decay invites you to consider whether something no longer needs to operate at its previous intensity.
Previous investment can make it difficult to reduce commitment. Yet when practical needs have changed, maintaining the same level of effort may no longer create comparable value.
A decline in activity does not automatically mean failure. Some work has served its purpose, some commitments can become less frequent, and some plans may benefit from a pause to restore resources.
The important task is to assess what should continue, what can decrease, and what requires preparation for another stage.

sections.title: How It May Appear in Real Life
paragraphs: Work & Projects

A digital product has completed its main development, with core features appropriately verified. The team may no longer need its original development intensity and can shift toward essential maintenance, customer support, and continued review.
Family & Everyday Life
After a household completes a move or renovation, the need for intensive coordination gradually decreases.
The family can organize records, address remaining obligations, and return to more manageable routines rather than maintaining the pace of the project indefinitely.
Personal Development
After reaching a learning milestone, someone may no longer need the same intensive course schedule.
Shifting time toward application, reviewing outcomes, or rest may be more useful than continually adding new learning commitments.

sections.title: A Helpful Approach
paragraphs: Adjust effort to current needs rather than preserving earlier intensity.
Review which tasks remain essential, which have served their main purpose, and which resources can move toward maintenance, recovery, or preparation.
Before reducing activity, ensure that existing commitments and continuing obligations remain appropriately covered.

sections.title: What to Watch For
paragraphs: The main risk is continually adding resources simply to preserve a previous level of activity.
When something no longer requires its original scale, maintaining or increasing commitments can create unnecessary costs.
The opposite risk is treating every temporary decline as a reason for immediate closure. Some activities are simply entering a lower-intensity stage without losing their long-term value.
Appropriate decline does not mean abandoning continuing responsibilities.

sections.title: One Small Action
paragraphs: 5. Choose an activity that previously required substantial effort.
6. Review whether its current needs and supporting conditions have changed.
7. Identify responsibilities that must continue.
8. Reduce one nonessential commitment where appropriate and redirect resources toward recovery or preparation.

en.frozenObservationQuestion: What no longer needs to be maintained at the same intensity?
interpretationBoundary: Fixed card meanings invite observation and reflection. They do not establish your current experiences, abilities or tensions, or predict the future.

This card represents the activation-decay stage within the ECR baseline window. It does not establish that your business, relationships, health, or other circumstances are declining, nor does it predict an ending. "Energy" refers to available resources and supporting conditions within the model, not a medical measurement. Practical decisions require verifiable evidence and consideration of continuing obligations.

zh-Hans.title: 收束
zh-Hans.subtitle: 当前窗口正在关闭，并接近结构转换

sections.title: 一句话理解
paragraphs: 结束不一定意味着失去。有些事情完成当前阶段后，需要整理成果、释放不再必要的负担，为下一阶段保留空间。

sections.title: 这张卡想提醒什么？
paragraphs: 生活中，许多事情都有不同的发展阶段。一项工作可能已经达到原本目标，一种生活安排可能不再适合当前需要，或者某个长期计划已经完成主要任务。
「收束」邀请你观察：哪些事情已经值得好好整理，而不是继续带入下一阶段？
适当结束，不代表必须否定过去。已经积累的知识、经验和成果，仍然可以保留并应用于未来。
真正有价值的收束，是确认哪些部分已经完成、哪些责任仍然存在，以及哪些可以不再继续占用资源。
结束不是空白，而是为下一种安排腾出位置。

sections.title: 现实中可能如何出现？
paragraphs: 工作与项目
一项数字产品已经完成既定开发与验收，可以将当前项目正式关闭，并把后续更新转入维护计划。
这样既能保留已经完成的成果，也能避免不断加入新功能，让原来的项目永远无法结束。
家庭与生活
家庭完成搬迁后，仍然需要整理旧居文件、确认未完成的付款或交接责任。
适当处理这些事项，可以让过去的安排获得清楚结尾，同时让新生活更容易稳定下来。
个人发展
一个人完成阶段性学习目标后，可以整理作品、记录已经掌握的能力，以及下一阶段仍需改善的部分。
不必因为还有更多知识可以学习，就认定当前阶段永远不能完成。

sections.title: 什么做法更有帮助？
paragraphs: 确认完成条件，整理成果，并明确剩余责任。
可以检查：
- 已经完成： 哪些成果已经获得实际验证？
- 仍需处理： 哪些责任、文件或承诺不能遗漏？
- 可以释放： 哪些工作已经不需要继续投入？
- 下一阶段： 哪些经验与资源值得保留？
收束不要求一次解决未来所有问题，只需要让当前阶段拥有清楚、真实的结束状态。

sections.title: 什么情况需要留意？
paragraphs: 收束最大的风险，是因为不愿意结束，而让已经完成的事情继续占据时间与资源。
另一种风险，则是为了尽快结束，忽略尚未履行的责任或必要交接。
真正的收束既不无限拖延，也不提前宣布完成。

sections.title: 现在可以做什么？
paragraphs: 1. 选择一件已经接近完成的事情。
2. 确认原本目标是否已经实现。
3. 列出尚未处理的必要责任。
4. 整理并保留重要成果。
5. 在符合实际完成条件后，正式结束当前阶段。

zh-Hans.frozenObservationQuestion: 什么已经值得好好结束，而不是继续拖进下一轮？
interpretationBoundary: 固定卡义用于观察和反思，不证明你目前的经历、能力或张力，也不预测未来。
这张卡表示 ECR 模型中基线窗口的时间性收束位置，并不代表系统已经确认你现实中的事业、关系或计划即将结束，也不预测任何事件的终结。实际收束必须根据已完成的成果、持续责任、相关人员的权益及可核实的现实条件判断。
sourceProposedQuestion: 什么已经值得好好结束，而不是继续拖进下一轮？

en.title: CLOSURE
en.subtitle: The current window is closing and approaching transition

sections.title: At a Glance
paragraphs: An ending does not necessarily mean loss. When a stage reaches its appropriate conclusion, organizing achievements and releasing unnecessary commitments can create room for what comes next.

sections.title: What This Card Invites You to Consider
paragraphs: Many activities move through different stages. A project may reach its intended objective, an established routine may no longer fit current needs, or a long-term plan may have fulfilled its main purpose.
Closure invites you to consider what deserves an appropriate conclusion rather than being carried indefinitely into the next stage.
Ending something does not require rejecting its past value. Knowledge, experience, and completed work can remain useful.
Meaningful closure distinguishes what has been completed, which responsibilities continue, and what no longer needs to occupy resources.
Closure is not emptiness. It creates room for another arrangement.

sections.title: How It May Appear in Real Life
paragraphs: Work & Projects
A digital product has met its agreed development and acceptance requirements. The project can be formally closed while future updates move into a separate maintenance plan.
This preserves completed achievements without allowing additional features to keep the original project open indefinitely.
Family & Everyday Life
After a household move, documents, outstanding payments, or handover responsibilities may still require attention.
Addressing these matters appropriately helps conclude the previous arrangement and allows the new routine to become more settled.
Personal Development
After reaching a learning milestone, someone can organize completed work, record demonstrated capabilities, and identify areas for further development.
The existence of more to learn does not mean the current stage can never be completed.

sections.title: A Helpful Approach
paragraphs: Confirm completion, organize outcomes, and clarify outstanding responsibilities.
Review:
- Completed: Which results have been verified?
- Outstanding: Which responsibilities or commitments remain?
- Releasable: Which activities no longer need continued investment?
- Next stage: Which resources and lessons are worth retaining?
Closure does not require solving every future problem. It provides an accurate conclusion to the current stage.

sections.title: What to Watch For
paragraphs: The main risk is continuing to invest in something that has already fulfilled its purpose.
The opposite risk is declaring closure prematurely while essential obligations or handovers remain unresolved.
Meaningful closure neither extends work indefinitely nor declares completion too early.

sections.title: One Small Action
paragraphs: 6. Choose something approaching completion.
7. Check whether its original objective has been achieved.
8. Identify essential outstanding responsibilities.
9. Organize and preserve valuable outcomes.
10. Formally close the current stage once its actual completion conditions are met.

en.frozenObservationQuestion: What now deserves a proper ending instead of being carried into the next cycle?
interpretationBoundary: Fixed card meanings invite observation and reflection. They do not establish your current experiences, abilities or tensions, or predict the future.

This card represents temporal closure within the ECR baseline window. It does not establish that a real-world business, relationship, or plan is approaching its end, nor does it predict the conclusion of any event. Actual closure must be evaluated through completed outcomes, continuing obligations, the rights of those involved, and verifiable circumstances.
sourceProposedQuestion: What now deserves a proper ending instead of being carried into the next cycle?
